about.label: About
about.title: A software team in Istanbul.
about.lead: We've worked as Candemsoft since 2025. We do two things: build software for clients, and build our own products.
about.clientBody: Company sites, e-commerce, support systems, finance platforms. We start by talking, and we finish by shipping and handing over.
about.ownBody: We design, build and publish our own mobile apps. Store reviews, user feedback and update cycles: we live with them on our own products too.

principles.title: Right first, then fast.
principles.body: The same quality bar on every project. Rushing means shortcuts that cost more later.

principles.title: We talk plainly.
principles.body: Scope, timeline and cost are written down from the start. If they change, you hear it first.

principles.title: We try new things and keep what works.
principles.body: The project's needs choose the technology, not trends.
